name: barbell hang snatch below the knees
description: A hang snatch started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a wide grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
